general_information.name: OH—MY LEGAL NAME? I MEAN, I THINK IT’S MARGARET… THERE’S A MIDDLE PART MAYBE, I’M NOT SURE WHAT YOU NEED EXACTLY. DO YOU MEAN THE FULL NAME ALL TOGETHER, LIKE ON PAPERWORK?
general_information.address: It’s 56 Birchmount Road… in Toronto, Ontario.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly the back pain, that’s been going on since the injury at work in 2019, and then… my mood’s been low, sleeping badly, and I just don’t have the interest I used to. I stopped going to church and the social groups too.
current_concerns.goals: Mostly I want the pain managed better… and I’d really like to get back to my choir.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_diagnoses: I don’t think I’ve ever been told a psychiatric diagnosis, no.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: I did a pain management group back in 2022… I think it was about 8 sessions at the hospital pain clinic.; In 2022.; About 8 sessions.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Hydromorphone.; Dose: 2 mg three times daily.; Start Or Duration: I started it in 2020.; Side Effects: Constipation.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes — duloxetine.; Dose: 60 mg each morning.; Start Or Duration: I started that one in 2023.; Side Effects: Mild nausea.

medical_history.surgical_history: Surgery: A lumbar discectomy.; Date: In 2020.; Details: No, nothing else that I know of.

medication_allergies.medication_allergies: Allergy 1: Name Or Description: Codeine.; Reaction: Nausea and vomiting.; Date Or Age: In 2015.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Canada Post.; Job Title: Postal worker.; Dates: 1992 to 2019.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born in Trinidad… then I moved to Toronto when I was 14. It was a warm household, from what I remember, and that’s about it really.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I finished high school in Toronto and started work when I was 20… that’s the main part I can think of.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m widowed. My marriage lasted 28 years.
personal_history.future_goals: I’d like to be well enough to look after my grandchildren.
